P3A06 45') and Bookmark 3: radio loops gen item = the literal names p3a01..p3a06, so the IRW item code IS the CIS variable name; nothing positional, Step 5b exempt, no verification_/verify_ files written. COLUMN CROSS-CHECK: three level-1 records agree for all 6 items -- ES2973 DATA LIST positions 40..45; ES2973 VARIABLE LABELS (/P3A01 'La Ser', /P3A02 'Onda Cero', /P3A03 'RNE', /P3A04 'COPE', /P3A05 'Otras cadenas locales/autonómicas', /P3A06 'Otras cadenas'); and the printed questionnaire grid rows with column markers (40)..(45). All asserted in .cache/spain_2012_reality_radio/build.R. Labels name the station, so no two can be swapped without being self-evident. TEXT (text_source=study_materials): item_text is the questionnaire's grid-row label, which equals the ES2973 variable label verbatim for all 6 (line-break hyphen in the scan joined: 'auto-nómicas' -> 'autonómicas'). P.3a's shared stem goes in instructions, verbatim: 'Y en una semana normal, ¿cuántos días escucha los informativos de las siguientes cadenas de radio que le voy a mencionar, sea a través de un aparato de radio o en el móvil, ordenador, etc.)?'. DEVIATION NOT TAKEN, DISCLOSED: the source prints an unmatched closing parenthesis before '?' (no opening parenthesis anywhere in the stem; identical in versions A and B) -- kept verbatim in instructions as a source typo; instructions_translated omits it. Note the stem has no comma after 'Y' (unlike P.5a). The questionnaire PDFs are image-only scans; wording read visually from 250-dpi renders of page 1 (.cache/spain_2012_reality_radio/crop_p3stem_A.png, crop_p3a_A/B.png) -- spot-check advisable. Versions A and B print P.3 and P.3a identically (compared side by side; FT2973 says the versions differ only in P.9, 12, 15, 21, 24, 26, 29). Dropped from instructions: 'P.3a.' numbering and the interviewer direction '(MOSTRAR TARJETA B).' (sibling precedent). OPTIONS: ES2973 VALUE LABELS (identical on P3A01..P3A06, asserted) label only 0 'Ninguno' and 7 'Todos' (plus 8 N.S., 9 N.C., -99 No procede); the questionnaire grid header prints 'Ninguno 1 2 3 4 5 6 Todos'. The respondent-facing show card TARJETA B (text layer of tarjetas2973tipoA.pdf and tipoB.pdf, same wording) prints every point: '0 NINGUNO, 1 DÍA, 2 DÍAS, 3 DÍAS, 4 DÍAS, 5 DÍAS, 6 DÍAS, 7 TODOS'. SOURCE CHOICE: option_text ships the card's words for resp 1..6 ('1 día' .. '6 días' -- the card's numeral plus its printed word, not a number padded in by IRW) and the value labels' mixed case 'Ninguno'/'Todos' for 0/7; card capitals rendered in sentence case (batch_579 press precedent, same card). All 6 items use all 8 levels. FILTER: P.3a is asked only of respondents who listen to radio news at all (P.3 codes 1-4; P.3 = 5 'Nunca' -> 'Pasar a P.4'). In DA2973 cols 40-45 are blank for 1571 records (1569 P.3=Nunca + 1 P.3=N.S. + 1 P.3=N.C.), and the .do leaves those missing; 0 of the 1385 live ids have P.3 outside 1..4. 0 'Ninguno' is a valid scale point (a radio listener who does not listen to that station). SENTINELS: the .do sets 8/9 to missing; raw 8/9 per item p3a01..06 = 6/18, 9/20, 8/23, 8/26, 6/21, 9/23. REBUILD: DA2973 (2962 records, width 392, ESTUDIO=2973, id = row number) cols 40..45 minus blanks and 8/9, cov_sex col 160, cov_age cols 384-385 (99 -> NA) reproduces the live table exactly: 8169 rows both, 1385 ids both, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt id-item keys, 0 duplicate keys, 0 resp / 0 cov_age mismatches, cov_sex 4498 Hombre / 3671 Mujer all on the diagonal (.cache/spain_2012_reality_radio/rebuild.R; live read from the local irw cache populated by table_context.R). Live item means (days/week): La Ser 1.88, Onda Cero 1.27, RNE 0.95, COPE 0.72, local/autonómicas 1.59, otras 1.07 -- coherent (Cadena SER the most-listened Spanish network). STEP 3b: dictionary Description ('Weekly listening frequency of radio stations') and the .do header ('radio (P3A01 to P3A06) 0-7 days per week listening to each of six radio stations') describe P.3a; 6 items, resp 0..7 match; no mismatch. Note the stem asks specifically about the stations' news bulletins ('informativos'), which the Description's 'listening frequency' generalises. validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (6 items, resp 0..7; 48 rows). language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation (CIS publishes Estudio 2973 in Spanish only; all _translated columns are English written by IRW; station names left untranslated; issues-page line owed once live). RIGHTS: applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, all CIS survey years, irw#2381); originator is CIS. No register row written.
public_note: Codes are days per week (0 = none, 7 = every day) of listening to each station's news bulletins; only respondents who said they listen to radio news at all were asked, so non-listeners have no rows, and don't-know/no-answer are stored as missing; English is IRW machine translation of the Spanish-only CIS questionnaire
